Class BedrockIrisGlint

java.lang.Object
com.viaversion.viafabricplus.bedrock.render.compat.iris.BedrockIrisGlint
public final class BedrockIrisGlint extends Object
Supplies native radiance through Iris's combined-glint API, retaining pack composition.
